title: TEXTMACHINA: Seamless Generation of Machine-Generated Text Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigated using length constrainers to automatically infer token lengths and a truncation algorithm in post-processing to ensure similar token-length distributions between human and generated texts.
Addressed by using prompt templates and extractors to inject specific topics from human sources into the generated texts to ensure content similarity.
Identified in strongly-structured domains (e.g., legal documents) and mitigated by guiding the generation formats to align with human text structures.
Removed during post-processing by stripping explicit LLM disclosure patterns (e.g., 'As an AI...') and special tokens like [BOS] or [EOS] from the generated text.
Addressed during post-processing by correcting mojibake and Unicode errors using the ftfy library.
Mitigated by using fastText language identification models to filter out and discard texts generated in a language different from that of the human texts.
Prevented by removing the extracted prefix from the original human sources so that both the human text and the machine-generated text are evaluated as continuations of the same prefix.
